subject: Classes
intro: Rankings based on solo clear speed, co-op value and current patch balance.

entries.name: Ranger
entries.note: High mobility and burst at range; the best solo class this patch.

entries.name: Warrior
entries.note: Forgiving bruiser with strong stagger and self-sustain.

entries.name: Mage
entries.note: Highest damage ceiling but squishy; shines in groups.

entries.name: Mystic
entries.note: Great in co-op, workable solo with the right weapon.
